From 6a320935fa4293e9e599ec9f85dc9eb3be7029f8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Chia-Ming Chang <chiamingc@synology.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 17:34:42 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] inotify: fix watch count leak when
 fsnotify_add_inode_mark_locked() fails

When fsnotify_add_inode_mark_locked() fails in inotify_new_watch(),
the error path calls inotify_remove_from_idr() but does not call
dec_inotify_watches() to undo the preceding inc_inotify_watches().
This leaks a watch count, and repeated failures can exhaust the
max_user_watches limit with -ENOSPC even when no watches are active.

Prior to commit 1cce1eea0aff ("inotify: Convert to using per-namespace
limits"), the watch count was incremented after fsnotify_add_mark_locked()
succeeded, so this path was not affected. The conversion moved
inc_inotify_watches() before the mark insertion without adding the
corresponding rollback.

Add the missing dec_inotify_watches() call in the error path.

Fixes: 1cce1eea0aff ("inotify: Convert to using per-namespace limits")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Chia-Ming Chang <chiamingc@synology.com>
Signed-off-by: robbieko <robbieko@synology.com>
Reviewed-by: Nikolay Borisov <nik.borisov@suse.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260224093442.3076294-1-chiamingc@synology.com
Signed-off-by: Jan Kara <jack@suse.cz>

diff --git a/fs/notify/inotify/inotify_user.c b/fs/notify/inotify/inotify_user.c
index 5e1845f2c25d..2edac3b39178 100644
--- a/fs/notify/inotify/inotify_user.c
+++ b/fs/notify/inotify/inotify_user.c
@@ -621,6 +621,7 @@ static int inotify_new_watch(struct fsnotify_group *group,
 	if (ret) {
 		/* we failed to get on the inode, get off the idr */
 		inotify_remove_from_idr(group, tmp_i_mark);
+		dec_inotify_watches(group->inotify_data.ucounts);
 		goto out_err;
 	}
 
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Patch Modifications

### File Modified: `fs/notify/inotify/inotify_user.c`

**Change:**
- In the `inotify_new_watch()` function, added a call to `dec_inotify_watches(group->inotify_data.ucounts)` in the error path after `fsnotify_add_inode_mark_locked()` fails.

**Context:**
- Earlier in the function, `inc_inotify_watches()` is called to increment the watch count before attempting to add the mark.
- When `fsnotify_add_inode_mark_locked()` fails, the code previously cleaned up by calling `inotify_remove_from_idr()` but did not decrement the watch count (`dec_inotify_watches()`), causing a leak.

### Relationship Between Modifications:
The single change is a one-line addition that completes the rollback sequence on failure:
- Original error handling: `inotify_remove_from_idr()` → `goto out_err`
- Fixed error handling: `inotify_remove_from_idr()` → `dec_inotify_watches()` → `goto out_err`

This ensures the watch count remains consistent with the number of active watches, preventing exhaustion of the `max_user_watches` limit (ENOSPC) due to leaked counts when mark insertion fails. The bug was introduced by commit 1cce1eea0aff which moved the increment before the mark insertion without adding the corresponding decrement in the failure path.
